# Strova Group

> Digital services, business automation, and software products under one technology business.

Strova Group is the parent brand. Strova Technology is its integrated technology business, organized around three connected pillars: Digital, Automation, and Products.

- **Canonical Origin**: https://strovagroups.in
- **Email**: info@strovagroups.in
- **Client support**: support@strovagroups.in

- **Headquarters**: Operating from India (Hours: Mon–Sat, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM IST / UTC+05:30)
- **Leadership & Ownership**: Sarthak Shreshth (Founder). Legal owner per Udyam: Babita Kumari, proprietor. Strova Group is a proprietorship of Babita Kumari.
- **MSME Registration**: UDYAM-JH-20-0147452
- **Commercial Model**: Fixed-scope written quotes delivered within 1 business day; 50% advance upon scope agreement and 50% upon staging demonstration prior to final handover. Invoices in INR or USD upon request.

## Divisions

- **Strova Technology** is the integrated technology business within Strova Group. Its three connected pillars are Digital, Automation, and Products (https://strovagroups.in/technologies/).
- **Digital**: Business websites and landing pages, web applications and customer portals, e-commerce solutions, and custom digital platforms.
- **Automation**: Business process and workflow automation, CRM and operational integrations, suitable AI-powered integrations, and repetitive task automation.
- **Products**: SaaS applications, reusable software products, digital tools, and platforms developed around validated customer needs.
